title: CandyGitServer — SugarCraft
description: CandyGitServer: a self-hostable Git server; the smart-HTTP transport (clone, fetch, auth-gated push, LFS) runs today via serve --http, with the SSH ForceCommand dispatcher and git-daemon advertisement at class level.
ogDescription: Smart-HTTP clone, fetch, auth-gated push and LFS live; SSH ForceCommand dispatcher and git-daemon advertisement at class level.
